race.comment: MARBLES (10) brings the clear form standard after debuting with a fifth in the G3 David Coles Stakes at Morphettville, beaten just under four lengths after racing keenly and being steadied near the 300m. She resumes off a Cranbourne trial win and that stakes exposure reads strongly for this.  BALLSINTHEAIR (2) is an interesting debutant for Gavin Bedggood, who has a 30% debut strike rate and the Cranbourne trial win gives him a solid starting point, watch the betting. CHANTESS (7) had genuine interference on debut at Pakenham before charging home for fourth, and barrier 1 gives her the chance to improve into the money. NAUTIQUE (13) was caught deep so made a dash forward before the turn then stuck on well to finish fourth last start over 1118m at Kyneton. Major player.
